title: Analytic: surface plasmon on a Drude metal / glass interface, mesh convergence (em_modes)
description:
A planar Drude metal / glass interface seen in cross-section: metal below y = 300 nm (the Drude metal of analytic_spp_drude: omega_p 1.37e16 rad/s, gamma 2e14 rad/s), glass eps_d = 2.25 above; x periodic (4 cells: the interface is infinite in x), pec on y_lo (inside the metal, ~14 metal decay lengths deep) and on y_hi (1.5 um of glass, ~8 glass decay lengths: no PML needed); mode_analysis at 633 nm with n_eff_guess = n_spp, swept over dx_cell = 4, 2, 1, 0.5 nm.
Analytic: n_spp = sqrt(eps_m eps_d / (eps_m + eps_d)) with the complex Drude eps_m at lambda0 (Im < 0 = loss); L_spp = lambda0 / (4 pi |Im n_spp|) (1/e power propagation length); |H_x| = H0 exp(-Re(kappa) |y - t_metal|) with kappa^2 = k0^2 (n_spp^2 - eps) on each side, H0 from the 1 W normalisation over the window width.
Derived values tab: n_eff_spp, n_eff_imag_spp, L_spp_measured and te_fraction_spp (0: the plasmon has E_y and E_z only) vs their references. Sweep tab: each vs dx_cell with the reference dashed. The error is first order in dx_cell: E_y on the interface face sees the arithmetic mean (eps_m + eps_d) / 2 where the normal field needs the harmonic one; estimated (not a closed form) n_eff about +0.4 % per nm of cell size, Im n_eff about 6.5 % and L_spp about 5 % per nm (26 % / 21 % at 4 nm, the tolerance 0.5 covers the coarsest run, judged at its worst sweep value), so each halving of dx_cell should about halve the errors.
Line profile tab: the analytic curve 'h_profile' (|H| along y across the interface) dashed over the h_abs line of the last (finest) run; the cell-centre averaging rounds the cusp at the interface.
Curves & tables tab: modes 2 and 3 are modes of the glass gap between the metal and the top wall (n_eff < 1.5), not part of the benchmark.

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the mode solve

parameters.name: t_metal
parameters.description: interface height = metal thickness (a cell edge for every dx_cell)

parameters.name: eps_m_re
parameters.description: Re eps of the metal at lambda0 (Drude, exp(+j omega t)), ~ -20.1

parameters.name: eps_m_im
parameters.description: Im eps of the metal at lambda0 (< 0 = loss), ~ -1.42

parameters.name: n2_re
parameters.description: Re n_spp^2, n_spp^2 = eps_m eps_d / (eps_m + eps_d)

parameters.name: L_spp
parameters.description: analytic 1/e propagation length of the plasmon power [m] (~7.2 um)

parameters.name: kappa_d_re
parameters.description: Re of the field decay constant into the glass [1/m] (1/e length ~190 nm)

parameters.name: kappa_m_re
parameters.expression: k_vac*sqrt((hypot(n2_re - eps_m_re, n2_im - eps_m_im) + n2_re - eps_m_re)/2)
parameters.description: Re of the field decay constant into the metal [1/m] (1/e length ~21 nm)

parameters.name: re_n_over_eps_m
parameters.description: Re(n_spp / eps_m) (< 0: the power flows backward in the metal)

parameters.name: H0_peak
parameters.description: |H_x| at the interface for 1 W over the window: P = Lx eta0 / 2 integral Re(n / eps) |H_x|^2 dy [A/m]

analytic_curves.name: h_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(y > t_metal, H0_peak*exp(-kappa_d_re*abs(y - t_metal)), H0_peak*exp(-kappa_m_re*abs(y - t_metal)))
